notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.27 Update
notes.content:
[b]Weapons Update & Character Customization[/b]

This build has some major updates to weapons and the introduction of basic character customization.  Only 3 of the armor sets are available for customization at this time, the rest will be added in soon!

[b]New Features / Major Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Base character customization functionality has been implemented
[*] All weapons have been converted to projectile based weapons.  This should completely eliminate any disconnect caused from projectile visuals not matching up exactly with instant hit recording caused by hitscan based weapons
[*] Most of the weapons have had new sounds and firing fx created for them (wait till you see how the energy weapons effect metal surfaces now!)
[*] Weapon sounds now have proper sound classes assigned to them and will respect the sound fx volume slider in the settings menu
[*] Player mid-flight collisions now have new sound fx
[*] Sector 0415, Nesis Red, and Reclamation arenas have all had visual updates
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several issues found in testing throughout the arenas have been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.25 Update
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes from pre-alpha testing and mid-air collision[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added check for available room when attempting to exit the crouched state, character should not stand up if does not have room to do so without clipping into something
[*] Infinite flight energy bug should was fixed
[*] Spawning outside the dome during drop-in on the Nesis-Red map was fixed
[*] Issue with score tracking objects beign created before players steam name was available, resulting in no scores being shown in leaderboard list has been fixed (did not have time to test this one so meh... :D)
[*] Issue with game shutting down after 5 minutes of running arenas offline for testing should be fixed
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added first iteration of mid-flight collision damage.  NOTE: This is the mid-flight collision / impact damage, NOT fall damage.  Fall damage has not been implemented yet.

Any collision that occurs during fast flight mode which is significant enough to force you back into hover mode, should now deal damage based on the velocity of movement at time of impact.  This damage goes BOTH ways if you collide into another player!!!   ie both of you will be damaged from the impact.  Damage to other players is AoE based, tiny AoE but still AoE, if you are really good, it is technically possible to slam yourself into a  group of others who are bunched up (for whatever reason) and Jenkins the whole lot of them. (yourself included!)

This also means that chasing someone through tight or twisting areas has now become a dangerous prospect if you are not all good and comfy with the flight controls.  You have been warned!
[/list]

[*] Issue with score tracking objects beign created before players steam name was available, resulting in no scores being shown in leaderboard list has been fixed (did not have time to test this one so meh... :D)
[*] Issue with game shutting down after 5 minutes of running arenas offline for testing should be fixed

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.24 Update
notes.content:
[b]Services+ Update[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added and implemented backend services sdk, server matchmaking, and dynamic server spinup as needed per match.  (ie game is no longer running on our little rented box!
[*] Added ability to dodge (default key to dodge is alt + direction you want to dodge
[*] Added velocity based rolling landings when land on the ground while traveling fast enough to make a normal landing improbable.
[*] Added dynamic ground detection while falling so character will start transitioning into a landing pose when nearing the ground based on air velocity of the fall.
[*] Added hip fire!  You kept asking for it, so we added it!  You can now fire without aiming, accuracy during hip fire will be reduced but you are free to spray and pray to your hearts content now!
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.21 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Territory[/b]

[b]New Arenas:[/b]
This patch brings you not one, but TWO new arenas to test your mettle in!  

[b]Nesis Red[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38556176/ba5ceae05192b8df82066ff0ae315bec208c24eb.png[/img]
The first of these lies deep in the swamplands where nature has run rampant.  With it's towering crystal cliffs, and plummeting waterfalls Nesis Red is every bit as beautiful as it is deadly.

[b]Reclamation[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38556176/3cc8af117c21e468b0b406a90397a7a9798b047e.png[/img]
The second of our new arenas takes you out into the scorching deserts.  What ancient secrets lie buried in this place?  Perhaps it is best not to know!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sniper rifle scopes are working again.
[/list]

tags.feature: This patch brings you not one, but TWO new arenas to test your mettle in!

tags.bug: Sniper rifle scopes are working again.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.15 Update
notes.content:
[b]Flight Networking Update[/b]

The flight systems networking has been completely revamped to be much more efficient.  Several aspects of flight have been improved during this process and performance overall should see a noticeable boost. 

Some of the things you shouldld notice:
[list]
[*] Occasional stutter during flight should be gone
[*] Flight overall should feel MUCH smoother and overall just better
[*] Character should be moving correctly during flight now (ie smooth interpolations rather than harsh turns)
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.12 Update
notes.content:
This is just a small update to address a few issues that have been in recent tests.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Issue where attempting to loot consumables from a chest when you already had the max allowed would result in those consumables not being lootable afterwards has been fixed
[*] Issue where pressing the aim button with no weapon equipped would result in improper changes to movement speed has been fixed
[*] Issue where combat damage text was scaled too small and appeared to not be functioning has been fixed.  Furthermore combat damage text has had some adjustments to be better visible in all scenarios
[*] Player character will now fade out if the camera collision detection causes it to move too close to the character and would result in the character blocking the view
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.0.11 Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the beginning of our build update notes!  Since we have the first group of regular testers going HAM on the game right now, we figured it was time to start posting these with patches.  

This update sees a lot of initial performance optimization passes that have greatly improved the games playability overall as well as several bug fixes.

[b]First Pass Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Massive optimization pass on textures used in the game
[*] First optimization pass on materials used in the game
[*] Further LOD optimizations
[*] Optimization pass on fog display in the arenas
[*] Lowered bloom levels in the arenas for better visuals
[*] Optimization pass on ice that covered floor of "Aufeis" arena
[/list]

[b]Arena Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Holes through the ice that led to underwater areas in "Aufeis" arena have been removed until the underwater systems are fully implemented
[*] More loot chest spawn locations added to "Connors Dam" arena
[*] All arenas now have working armor repair stations in them, stations are marked as medical symbols on the compass 
[*] Lighting has been adjusted for better display of  the character
[*] Contact shadows enabled for detail on foliage
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Icons have been added to all tabs on the screenshot utility
[*] Projectiles across the board have been sped up between 100% and 300%
[*] The above/Below ground detection in the global tracking system has been updated and now properly shows the tracked players state in this matter.  Differing markers have been added to easily distinguish between a tracked player being above pro underground.  These markers will update dynamically in real time as long as they are active as well.  
[*] A green diamond with the top half filled in will designate a player who is above ground
[*] A goldish-brown diamond marker with the bottom half filled in will designate a player who is below ground
[*] Very basic base implementation of freefall animations have been added.  This is no where near complete and very much a WIP
[/list]

[b]Bug FIxes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed floating chests in arenas
[*] Many chests have had their possible spawn locations adjusted for better feel in the scene
[*] Fixed all reported holes in meshes/terrain/collision
[*] Ground dust particles in flight will no longer be triggered by the underground detection triggers
[*] Issue with chest spawners fixed that was causing high amounts of rubber-banding / lag
[*] Steam name not showing on main menu fixed
[*] Steam name now shows in game hud version text
[*] Observer camera now shows steam name of player being watched
[/list]
